name: Web app
description: A real web app with Laravel and Vue. An agent helps you build it, step by step.

agent.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and BRIEF.md, then say hi using my profile if there is one. Run .kids-workbench/scripts/doctor.sh, then scripts/bootstrap.sh, and propose a small first milestone for PLAN.md.
agent.resume: Welcome back. Read PLAN.md and BRIEF.md, tell me where we are in two or three lines, and suggest the next small step.
